series.name: All Homage AC splits — Element (HES) / eSmart-Crystal (HCS-HSC) / Classic / Smart Cool / Prestige (HPS) / Grande
series.notes: Homage (R&I Electrical Appliances — same company as Kenwood PK) AC range verified on homage.pk: inverter Element (HES), eSmart/Smart Crystal (HCS/HSC), Homage Classic, Smart Cool, Prestige (HPS); non-inverter Grande. Wall splits only — no floor-standing/cassette line found. DOCUMENTED GAP: no official Homage AC error-code table or service manual exists (homage.pk has none; aysonline.pk/docs Homage page 404; none on Scribd). Only one low-confidence community code (F1) found in an anonymous forum comment, itself contested. Kenwood shares the R&I platform but Kenwood codes were NOT imported — shared platform is plausible, unconfirmed. Reset: remote OFF → breaker OFF 5–10 min → breaker ON → remote ON. Support: 021-111-764-111.

title.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor ki fault (reported)

meaning.en: A Homage user reported F1 as an outdoor ambient temperature sensor fault. Only one anonymous comment supports this; a reply on the same thread claimed communication error instead.
meaning.ur: Ek Homage user ne F1 ko outdoor ambient temperature sensor fault bataya. Sirf ek anonymous comment isko support karta hai; usi thread ke ek reply mein communication error kaha gaya.

causes.en: Outdoor ambient sensor disconnected or failed (per reported claim)
causes.ur: Outdoor ambient sensor disconnect ya kharab (reported claim ke mutabiq)

causes.en: Meaning is brand-specific — no Homage manual confirms it
causes.ur: Meaning brand-specific hai — koi Homage manual confirm nahi karti

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

source.title: iPhonewired thread on Kenwood F1 video — user comments mentioning Homage F1

notes.en: Sole Homage AC code found after 30+ searches. Same thread contested (sensor vs communication). F1 is brand-specific (Kenwood=ambient sensor, Orient=PCB, Haier=IPM) — verify on the exact model before trusting. App must show 'verify on your model' badge.
notes.ur: 30+ searches ke baad yehi ek Homage AC code mila. Usi thread par contest hai (sensor vs communication). F1 brand-specific hai (Kenwood=ambient sensor, Orient=PCB, Haier=IPM) — exact model par verify karein. App par 'verify on your model' badge zaroori hai.
